name: Rinka to, Hokago no 5-byou
source: A short, fully voiced visual novel about the five quiet seconds after the school bell. Rinka, your classmate, asks if you have time after class. Walk home with her or meet her in the library, then answer one question on the rooftop at sunset. 3 endings. Made by Rinka World Production Committee; Rinka is an original character.
